description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between  A. W. K. Perera vs. Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders and revocations of orders under Section 4(1) of the Act. It involves the appointment of arbitrators for industrial disputes and the revocation of previous arbitration orders, which falls under legal notices and regulatory procedures. While a minister is named (Ravindra Samaraweera), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or portfolio assignments, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
